description: With a fixed countable stock of free variable names, the scoped formulas in a set-sized language \(L\), over all finite bound-variable contexts, form a set of cardinality at most \(\max(\aleph_0,|L|)\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.card_le.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'} :
  Cardinal.mk ((n : ℕ) × L.BoundedFormula α n) ≤
    max Cardinal.aleph0 (Cardinal.lift.{max u v, u'} (Cardinal.mk α) + Cardinal.lift.{u', max u v} L.card)
